text: SAR filed for structuring activity on ACC-10042 (Petrov Trading LLC). Subject Viktor Petrov made 6 cash deposits totaling $55,000 over 3 days at 4 branch locations, each below $10,000 CTR threshold. Pattern consistent with deliberate structuring under 31 USC 5324.

SAR filed for elder financial exploitation of ACC-10028 (Margaret King, age 82). Grandson added as authorized signer withdrew $45,000 over 2 weeks. Victim unaware of withdrawals until bank notification. APS referral made concurrent with SAR.

SAR filed for money mule network. 5 accounts (ACC-10050 through ACC-10054) used as pass-through for BEC proceeds. Subjects are college students recruited via Instagram ads. Total throughput $89,000 over 45 days.

SAR filed for counterfeit check scheme targeting ACC-10027 (Allen's Auto Body). Four counterfeit checks drawn on non-existent accounts deposited via mobile. Check images appear professionally produced.

SAR filed for romantic scam. Susan Clark (victim) wired $78,000 to overseas accounts over 3 months at direction of online romance scammer. Beneficiary accounts in Nigeria and Ghana. Victim reported after family intervention.

SAR filed for insider threat. Teller employee EMP-T0044 correlated with 5 fraud cases. Employee waived holds on counterfeit check deposits and is suspected of providing customer PII to external fraud ring.
SAR filed for payroll fraud. Ghost employee scheme at TechCorp Inc diverted $67,500 in payroll deposits over 6 months to accounts at our institution. Subject: TechCorp payroll administrator.
SAR filed for IRS impersonation scam. Carlos Rivera (victim) wired $8,500 to scammer posing as IRS agent. Wire sent to domestic mule account then forwarded offshore. IC3 complaint filed.
SAR filed for account takeover via SIM swap. ACC-10011 (Rachel Adams) compromised after attacker ported phone number. Unauthorized wire of $12,400 to domestic account. Funds recovered via recall.

SAR filed for real estate money laundering. All-cash purchase of $1.2M property facilitated through ACC-10039 (Steven Jackson Real Estate). Beneficial owner traced to foreign PEP. FinCEN GTO filing also submitted.
SAR filed for tax refund fraud. 12 fraudulent tax refund direct deposits totaling $38,400 received at ACC-10050. Refunds filed using stolen SSNs. IRS Criminal Investigation notified.

SAR filed for human trafficking financial indicators. ACC-10050 showed deposits from multiple unrelated individuals, cash withdrawals near known trafficking corridor, and prepaid card purchases. DHS notified.

SAR filed for invoice factoring fraud. Baker Auto Parts (ACC-10014) sold $120,000 in fabricated invoices to factoring company. Invoices referenced fictitious customers and non-existent purchase orders.

SAR filed for third-party payment processor abuse. Merchant processed $340,000 for undisclosed sub-merchants selling counterfeit goods. Payment processor agreement violated merchant underwriting standards.
SAR filed for dormant account compromise. ACC-10055 dormant for 3 years reactivated with fraudulent deposits and wire transfer. Account credentials compromised via data breach at third-party service.

SAR filed for Ponzi scheme. Investment company account (ACC-10060) received $890,000 in customer deposits routed primarily to principal's personal accounts. Classic Ponzi indicators: returns paid from new investor deposits.
SAR filed for beneficial ownership concealment. Three LLCs (ACC-10070, ACC-10071, ACC-10072) traced to same undisclosed beneficial owner through nominee director network. CTA violation.
SAR filed for correspondent banking abuse. Foreign bank processed $2.4M for customers in sanctioned jurisdiction through our correspondent account. Relationship terminated.

SAR filed for crypto-ATM structuring. Individual made 22 cash purchases at Bitcoin ATM, each under $3,000, totaling $62,000. KYC threshold circumvention at crypto-ATM operated by third party in branch lobby.
SAR filed for counterfeit card manufacturing ring. 45 counterfeit cards linked to data breach used at 8 of our ATMs. $9,600 in fraudulent withdrawals. Law enforcement recovered card blanks.

SAR filed for peer-to-peer payment laundering network. 15 Venmo/Zelle accounts aggregated small payments into consolidation account. Total throughput $102,000 over 3 months. Pattern consistent with narcotics proceeds.
SAR filed for loan stacking. Applicant obtained loans from 4 institutions within 30 days using name variations. Total debt exceeds 200% of DTI capacity. Coordinated fraud suspected.
SAR filed for illegal online gambling. Merchant account processed $560,000 coded as software consulting but traced to offshore gambling platform. Merchant terminated. UIGEA violation.
SAR filed for gift card laundering scheme. 200+ prepaid gift cards purchased using stolen credit card numbers. Cards resold on secondary market. $42,000 total across 15 merchant locations.
SAR filed for trade-based money laundering. Import company over-invoiced goods by 300%, moving $2.1M in excess value through trade finance instruments. Customs referral made.
SAR filed for FedNow real-time payment exploitation. Compromised credentials used to initiate 8 instant payments totaling $12,000 in 3 minutes. 5 blocked by real-time fraud detection.
SAR filed for deepfake voice fraud attempt. AI-generated voice impersonating CEO requested $225,000 wire transfer. Wire desk detected callback discrepancy. No funds lost. FBI IC3 referral.
SAR filed for BEC wire fraud at Apex Manufacturing. Controller wired $187,500 to fraudulent beneficiary in Dubai based on spoofed CFO email. Partial recovery of $142,000 via SWIFT recall.

SAR filed for synthetic identity fraud ring. 8 accounts across 4 institutions using SSNs belonging to minors. ACC-10091 identified as part of the ring. Total exposure $180,000. Joint 314(b) investigation.
SAR filed for check kiting. Coastal Ventures LLC exchanged 14 circular checks totaling $156,000 between ACC-10034 and ACC-10035 in 10 days. Both accounts show negative collected balances.

SAR continuation filing for Viktor Petrov / Petrov Trading LLC. Updated narrative includes expanded network analysis: 7 connected entities across 4 jurisdictions. Total fund flow $284,750. New beneficiaries identified in Latvia and Lithuania.

SAR filed for document forgery. CUST-20088 submitted forged Latvian passport (DOC-F9088) during account opening. Font inconsistencies, metadata tampering, and template match to known fraud template detected.
SAR filed for document forgery ring. 8 accounts opened with professionally forged driver's licenses from 3 states. Shared IP addresses and biometric anomalies link the applications.
SAR filed for cryptocurrency off-ramp activity. ACC-10088 transferred $59,500 to CryptoXchange Ltd (Estonia) over 10 days. Funds converted to Bitcoin. Transaction trail breaks at exchange boundary.
SAR filed for ACH return manipulation. 25 fraudulent ACH debits harvesting $18,750 in provisional credits. Funds withdrawn via ATM before holds placed. Source accounts at 3 other institutions.
SAR filed for merchant skimming at Kim's BBQ. POS terminal overlay device captured 34 customer card numbers. Device recovered by law enforcement. Merchant cooperated fully.
SAR filed for pump and dump securities fraud. Customer traded $180,000 in penny stocks coordinated with social media promotion. Rapid liquidation followed by wire transfer of proceeds offshore.
SAR filed for ATM cash-out attack. Coordinated withdrawal from 12 ATMs simultaneously using cloned cards. $24,000 withdrawn in 4 minutes. Cards linked to Eastern European carding forum.

SAR filed for unauthorized account opening using stolen identity. Victim reported identity theft after receiving welcome letter for ACC-10090 which they did not open. Synthetic elements combined with victim's SSN.

SAR filed for phishing campaign targeting online banking customers. 47 customers received credential harvesting emails. 8 submitted credentials. 3 accounts had unauthorized transactions before detection.

SAR filed for mobile banking trojan. Customer's Android device infected with banking trojan that intercepted MFA codes and initiated unauthorized transfers. Two transfers totaling $6,800 to mule accounts.
SAR filed for corporate account compromise. ACC-10067 online banking credentials stolen via spear-phishing. 2 unauthorized ACH payments totaling $45,000 initiated. Both returned before settlement.

SAR filed for OFAC screening match on Petrov network wire. Wire from ACC-10042 to Meridian Holdings Ltd returned 85% name match to SDN entry. Wire held pending OFAC determination. Voluntary self-disclosure submitted.

SAR filed for rapid fund movement on new account ACC-10099 (Baltic Import Group). $47,000 deposited and immediately wired to Latvia and Lithuania within 2 weeks of account opening. Shell company indicators present.
SAR continuation for card-not-present fraud on ACC-10023. Investigation revealed card data compromised via third-party food delivery app data breach. 7 unauthorized transactions totaling $3,847.50.

Initial SAR filing for Viktor Petrov / Petrov Trading LLC structuring. 6 cash deposits below $10,000 across 4 branches in 3 days. Total $55,000. This is the original SAR referenced in subsequent Petrov network investigations.

SAR filed for wire fraud facilitated by compromised vendor email. Accounts payable department at manufacturing client redirected 3 vendor payments totaling $92,000 to fraudulent accounts based on forged invoice redirect emails.

SAR filed for suspicious account activity. New customer opened account with $500 and received $22,000 from 3 payroll sources within 45 days. Customer's claimed employer unverifiable. CMRA address. SSN belongs to minor.
